titulo.estudio: Les sons dans les mots : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: Common spellings and sounds: vocabulary and forms

intro: Read frequent combinations and silent endings in familiar words. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Read frequent combinations and silent endings in familiar words. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.

Point to note: Ou, oi and au/eau have frequent correspondences; the pronunciation of ai varies depending on the word; many final consonants are silent, with exceptions. In this passage, «eau» means «water».
